text:
Nora Vega: kicking off thread for the CloudMarket + Integration co-marketing. Need owners for launch blog, marketplace asset pack, bench narrative, webinar ops, and lead routing. Short answers ok.
Miles Huang: I can take the blog and the publish cadence. Propose publish 7 days before webinar. Need partner quote + logo.
Priya Rao: Webinar ops: Nov 20 at 17:00 UTC works for events. Run-of-show: 5m intro, 20m product demo, 10m benchmarks, 15m partner/customer panel, 10m Q&A. Dry run Nov 17.
Diego Silva: Bench scope: three KPIs only: p50 latency @256 & @1024, throughput on a 4-GPU pod, and cost per 1k tokens. Keep methods short, link to repo. Recommend using redwood-balanced config.
Nora Vega: Marketplace assets needed: 1200x628 co-brand hero, logo (png/svg), 200-250 word blurb, 2 screenshots. Deadline Oct 28.
Miles Huang: Blog outline: partner value props, 3-step setup, benchmark highlights, CTA. Draft by Oct 21.
Priya Rao: Promo windows: announce T-21, reminder T-7, final T-1, replay T+1. Also request 30s partner promo clip for socials.
Diego Silva: Routing: marketplace leads -> HubSpot -> tag cloud_marketplace_nov -> assign region queue. SLA 24h. Add lead_age and product_interest fields.
Nora Vega: UTM: utm_source=cloudmarket, utm_medium=partner, utm_campaign=cloud-int-nov. Use everywhere.
Miles Huang: I'll need the partner quote and headshot by Oct 18.
Priya Rao: I'll draft invites and calendar, will confirm host next sync.
Diego Silva: I'll start bench runs once infra is locked; target numbers by Oct 24.
marketing-bot: Reminder: "CloudMarket Launch dry run" scheduled for 2024-11-17 15:00 UTC.
